Button.usage: Ant's Button: children is its text; color (primary, default, danger) with variant (solid, outlined, dashed, filled, text, link); block fills the width; onClick. For a destructive button set color danger.

Input.usage: Ant's Input in a Form.Item: label, value, placeholder, extra (help text), allowClear, prefix/suffix, addonBefore/addonAfter; onChange, onPressEnter; setFieldValue, resetFields (back to the value property). The Validation section sets isValid.

TextArea.usage: Ant's Input.TextArea: label, value, placeholder, extra, minRows/maxRows (autoSize), showCount with maxLength.

InputNumber.usage: Ant's InputNumber: label, value (a number, empty for none), min, max, step, precision, prefix, addonAfter; onChange, onStep.

Select.usage: Ant's Select: label, options [{label, value}], mode ('' single, 'multiple', 'tags' for free-text tags), value (the picked value; an array in multiple and tags modes, with selectedOptions), placeholder, allowClear, showSearch; selectedOption is exposed in single mode; onChange fires on every change, clearing included.

DatePicker.usage: Ant's DatePicker: label, value YYYY-MM-DD (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss with showTime), showTime (a date-time picker), format (display), picker (date, week, month, quarter, year), minDate, maxDate; onChange.

Checkbox.usage: Ant's Checkbox: children is its label; checked; onChange; setFieldValue(checked), toggle.

Switch.usage: Ant's Switch with a Form.Item label beside it (layout horizontal): checked, checkedChildren/unCheckedChildren; onChange.

RadioGroup.usage: Ant's Radio.Group: label, options [{label, value}], value, optionType (default, button), buttonStyle, vertical; onChange.

Segmented.usage: Ant's Segmented: options [{label, value}], value (empty: the first), block; onChange.

Rate.usage: Ant's Rate: value, count, allowHalf; onChange.

Slider.usage: Ant's Slider: value, min, max, step; onChange while dragging, onChangeComplete on release.

Tag.usage: Ant's Tag: children is its text; color is a status (success, processing, warning, error), a palette name (blue, gold, purple...) or any CSS colour.

Badge.usage: Ant's status Badge: a coloured dot with text (status success, processing, default, error, warning), or a count bubble.

Alert.usage: Ant's Alert: message (the title), description, type (info, success, warning, error), showIcon, closable, banner.

Title.usage: Ant's Typography.Title: children is the text, level 1 (largest) to 5, type (secondary, success, warning, danger).

Text.usage: Ant's Typography.Paragraph: children is the text, type (secondary, success, warning, danger), strong, italic, code, ellipsis (rows).

Statistic.usage: Ant's Statistic (in a card by default): title, value (a number, formatted by formatter auto, number, currency, percent, compact; currency; precision), prefix, suffix, and a trend line: trend up/down/neutral, trendValue, extra.

Table.usage: Ant's Table: dataSource, columns (Ant's [{title, dataIndex, format?, align?, width?, sorter?}] or UI 2.0's [{name, key, type}]; format/type number, currency or currency:EUR, percent, date, datetime, tag/badge/status, boolean, html (sanitised markup; columnType 'html' too); empty shows every field), rowKey, pagination with pageSize, rowSelection (none, checkbox, radio), size, bordered, currency, tagColors. selectedRow (clicked), selectedRowKeys and selectedRows are exposed; onRowClick.

Tabs.usage: Ant's Tabs: items [{key, label}], each tab a canvas of child components (slot tab_<key>); activeKey; type (line, card); onChange; setActiveKey.

Card.usage: Ant's Card: title, extra (top right text), variant (outlined, borderless), size; its body is a canvas of child components (slot body).

Modal.usage: Ant's Modal: title, content (text), a body canvas of components (slot body, bodyHeight), okText, cancelText, okType (primary, danger), footer, width; open is exposed; a trigger button on the canvas (showTrigger, triggerText); actions show, hide; events onOk, onCancel, afterOpen, afterClose.

List.usage: Ant's List: dataSource; renderItem 'meta' (List.Item.Meta: titleField, descriptionField, avatarField (image URL or a name), extraField, badgeField (status Tag)) or 'components' (rows of child components reading {{listItem}}, rowHeight); header, footer, bordered, pageSize; selectedItem; onItemClick.

Column.usage: Ant's Column chart (@ant-design/plots): data, xField, yField (one field or several, each a series; or long data with colorField), stack, horizontal (Ant's Bar), yFormatter, legend; onElementClick with selectedDatum.

Line.usage: Ant's Line chart: data, xField, yField (one or several), colorField, smooth, point, yFormatter.

Area.usage: Ant's Area chart: data, xField, yField (one or several), colorField, stack, smooth.

Pie.usage: Ant's Pie chart: data, angleField (the value), colorField (the category), innerRadius (0 pie, 0.6 donut), label, legend.

Progress.usage: Ant's Progress: percent (0 to 100), type (line, circle, dashboard), status (normal, active, success, exception), steps, title.

Avatar.usage: Ant's Avatar: src, children (text without an image; a full name shows initials), shape, size (px).

Divider.usage: Ant's Divider: children (text in the line), orientation, dashed, type (horizontal, vertical).

Result.usage: Ant's Result: status (success, info, warning, error, 404, 403, 500), title, subTitle.

Descriptions.usage: Ant's Descriptions: items ([{label, children or value, format or type}], [label, value] pairs, or an object of label: value; types number, currency, percent, date, datetime, boolean, tag, link), title, extra, column, bordered, layout, currency.

Steps.usage: Ant's Steps: items [{title, description}], current (from 0), direction, type, status, progressDot; next, prev, setCurrent; onChange when clickable.

Timeline.usage: Ant's Timeline: items [{children, label, color}], mode (left, alternate, right), pending, reverse.

Upload.usage: Ant's Upload: type drag (Upload.Dragger area, fills the box) or select (a button); text, hint, accept, multiple, maxCount, listType. Files stay in the browser: fileList exposes [{uid, name, size, type, base64, content}] for a query; onChange, onRemove; resetFields clears.

TimePicker.usage: Ant's TimePicker: label, value as 24-hour text (HH:mm, or HH:mm:ss when format has seconds), format (display), use12Hours, minuteStep; onChange.

RangePicker.usage: Ant's DatePicker.RangePicker: label, value [start, end] as YYYY-MM-DD (startDate and endDate also exposed), format, picker, minDate, maxDate; onChange.

AutoComplete.usage: Ant's AutoComplete: free text with suggestions; label, options [{label, value}] or strings, value, placeholder, filterOption; onChange, onSelect, onSearch.

TreeSelect.usage: Ant's TreeSelect: label, treeData [{title, value, children}], value (an array when multiple or treeCheckable), placeholder, showSearch, treeDefaultExpandAll; onChange.

Cascader.usage: Ant's Cascader: label, options [{label, value, children}], value (the path array), changeOnSelect, expandTrigger; onChange.

ColorPicker.usage: Ant's ColorPicker: label, value (hex, or rgb() with format rgb), showText, presets [{label, colors}], allowClear; onChange while picking, onChangeComplete when done.

Transfer.usage: Ant's Transfer: two lists; dataSource [{key, title}], targetKeys (the chosen keys, exposed), titles, showSearch, oneWay; onChange.

Collapse.usage: Ant's Collapse: items [{key, label}], each panel a canvas of child components (slot panel_<key>, panelHeight); activeKey (open panel keys), accordion (one at a time), ghost, bordered; onChange.

Dropdown.usage: Ant's Dropdown on a Button: children (button text), items [{key, label, danger?}], type (default, primary), trigger, placement, split (Dropdown.Button). onClick fires for a menu item with selectedKey exposed; onButtonClick for a split button's own half.

Menu.usage: Ant's Menu: items [{key, label, children?}], mode (inline, vertical, horizontal), theme (light, dark), selectedKey (exposed, settable); onClick and onSelect carry the key.

Breadcrumb.usage: Ant's Breadcrumb: items [{title, key}] or strings, separator; onClick for an item with clickedKey exposed (the last item is the current page and not a link).

Pagination.usage: Ant's Pagination: current, pageSize, total, showSizeChanger, simple, size, showTotal text with {start} {end} {total}, align; onChange (current and pageSize exposed).

Drawer.usage: Ant's Drawer: a side panel; title, extra, placement (right, left, top, bottom), size (default, large) or width, body is a canvas of child components (slot body); open exposed; trigger button (showTrigger, triggerText); actions show, hide; events onClose, afterOpen, afterClose.

Skeleton.usage: Ant's Skeleton placeholder: active, avatar, title, rows; loading false hides it.

Spin.usage: Ant's Spin: spinning, tip, size (small, default, large).

Image.usage: Ant's Image: src, alt, preview (click to enlarge), fallback, objectFit; empty src shows a placeholder.

Calendar.usage: Ant's Calendar: value (YYYY-MM-DD, exposed), fullscreen (month grid) or a small card, events [{date, title, type}] drawn in the cells; onSelect, onPanelChange.

Tree.usage: Ant's Tree: treeData [{title, key, children}], checkable, defaultExpandAll, showLine; selectedKeys and checkedKeys exposed; onSelect, onCheck.

Carousel.usage: Ant's Carousel of images: items [{src, title, description}], autoplay, autoplaySpeed, dots, arrows, effect; afterChange with current exposed.

QRCode.usage: Ant's QRCode: value (text or URL), size, color, bgColor, errorLevel, icon, bordered.

Bar.usage: Ant's Bar chart (horizontal bars): data, xField (the category), yField (one or several series), colorField, stack; onElementClick.

DualAxes.usage: Ant's DualAxes: data, xField, yField [left, right] each on its own axis, geometry [left, right] of column or line, yFormatter; onElementClick.

Funnel.usage: Ant's Funnel: data [{stage, value}], xField (the stage), yField (the value); labels show the value and the share of the first stage.

Gauge.usage: Ant's Gauge: target (the value), total (the end of the scale), name, thresholds (ends of colour bands, e.g. [40, 70, 100]), formatter.

Radar.usage: Ant's Radar: data (one row per axis), xField (the axis name), yField (one or several series), area.

Scatter.usage: Ant's Scatter: data, xField and yField (numbers), colorField (a group), sizeField (bubbles).

Heatmap.usage: Ant's Heatmap of cells: data [{x, y, value}], xField, yField (categories), colorField (the value), label.

Kanban.usage: A board of Ant Cards: dataSource (the cards) grouped by statusField into columns [{id, title, color}] (a status no column lists gets its own column). cardLayout 'fields' shows titleField, descriptionField, badgeField (a Tag; badgeColors maps value to colour), tagsField, progressField (0 to 100), metaField, avatarField (name or image URL) and detailsField (Descriptions on the clicked card); 'custom' makes each card a row of ToolJet components reading {{cardData}} or {{listItem}} (cardHeight). density, collapsedHeight, columnWidth (empty fills the board), showCount, collapsibleColumns, collapsedColumns, emptyText. Cards move by drag or keyboard (allowDrag): onCardMoved with lastCardMovement {cardId, from, to, card, destinationColumnId} and updatedCardData (every card). onCardSelected (lastSelectedCard), allowAdd (onAddCardClick, addCardColumn), allowDelete (onCardRemoved, lastRemovedCard), onUpdate after every change; actions addCard(card, columnId), moveCard(cardId, columnId), deleteCard(cardId), updateCardData(cardId, values). Styles: column and card colours, radii, gap, progressColor, cardShadow.

Chat.usage: A chat in Ant parts: title, initialChat (history [{message, type: message|response}]), userName/userAvatar, respondentName/respondentAvatar, placeholder, emptyText, showAvatars, showTimestamps, allowClear, allowDownload, responseLoading (typing dots), historyLoading, inputDisabled. onMessageSent with lastMessage (and history) exposed; answer with appendHistory({message, type: 'response'}) and setResponseLoading(false).

Hero.usage: A page header: eyebrow, title, subTitle, meta, actionLabel and secondaryActionLabel (Ant Buttons; onActionClicked, onSecondaryActionClicked), asideValue/asideLabel (a Statistic), icon (Ant icon name or word), background (plain, tint, gradient, image with imageUrl, dark, solid), align, size.

SummaryStrip.usage: A row of Ant Statistics: items [{label, value, format?, delta, deltaFormat?, tone?, lowerIsBetter?, caption}], valueFormat, currency, deltaFormat, appearance (panel, plain, cards), size, align.

Schedule.usage: Resources down the side, time across: resources, bookings (resourceField, startField, endField, titleField, subtitleField, statusField), scale hours (date, dayStart, dayEnd, slotMinutes) or days (days); onBookingClicked (selectedBooking), onSlotClicked (selectedSlot).

RecordList.usage: An Ant List of records: dataSource, titleField, avatarField, metaFields, statusField (Tag), valueField (valueFormat, currency), progressField; size, split, bordered; onItemClicked with selectedItem, selectedItemId, selectedItemIndex.

CardGrid.usage: A grid of Ant Cards: dataSource, titleField, subtitleField, imageField (cover), badgeField/badgeFields (Tags), eyebrowField, avatarField, descriptionField, progressField, metaFields; columns (0 fits minCardWidth), imageAspect, variant, hoverable; onCardClicked with selectedItem.

Questionnaire.usage: One question at a time: items [{name, prompt, type: single|multiple|text, choices, other?, required?}], defaultAnswers, shortcuts, showProgress, submitLabel, completeTitle, completeText. answers, currentIndex, isComplete exposed; onStepChanged, onSubmit; actions reset, goTo.

ProgressList.usage: Rows of Ant Progress bars: dataSource, labelField, valueField, targetField or percentField, captionField, statusField, valueFormat, currency, autoTone (goal, limit), showValues, showPercent, size; onItemClicked.

Sparkline.usage: Ant's Tiny chart: data (numbers or rows with valueField), type (line, area, column), smooth, colorByTrend, lowerIsBetter, color; trend and lastValue exposed; onClick.

RadialChart.usage: A ring: mode progress (value of maxValue, Ant Progress dashboard or circle, centerValue, centerLabel) or categories (Ant RadialBar of data with categoryField, valueField); strokeWidth, colors, showLegend; onClick with clickedDataPoint.

Map.usage: Leaflet map: data (rows with latField/lngField), titleField, subtitleField, statusField (colours), popupFields, clusterMarkers, routes, areas, display (markers, heat, both), pickLocation, showSearch, mapStyle, fitToMarkers; selectedMarker, clickedLocation, pickedLocation, center, zoom exposed; onMarkerClick, onMapClicked, onLocationPicked, onBoundsChange.

Tags.usage: A row of Ant Tags: tags (strings or {label, color}), tagColors, variant (filled, outlined, solid), overflow (wrap, single, scroll), round; onTagClicked with lastClickedTag.

Link.usage: Ant's Typography.Link: children (text), href, target (_blank, _self), underline (hover, always, none), strong, showIcon; onClick, onHover; actions click, setHref, setChildren.

Icon.usage: An @ant-design/icons icon: icon (Ant name such as TeamOutlined, or a word such as users, cart, trending-up), size, type (default, muted, primary, success, warning, danger), chip (none, circle, square), chipSize; onClick.

ButtonGroup.usage: Ant Buttons joined (Space.Compact): buttons [{value, label, icon?}], mode (actions: onClick with lastClicked; single or multiple: value, onChange), type, size, direction, block, label; actions setSelected, clear.

CircularProgress.usage: Ant's Progress type circle (or dashboard): percent, size, strokeWidth, strokeLinecap, format (percent, custom with text, none), label, status; action setPercent.

Combobox.usage: Ant's searchable Select: label, options [{label, value}], value, placeholder, notFoundContent, allowClear, filterOption (off when a query fetches options on onSearch, reading searchValue); selectedOption, selectedLabel exposed; onChange, onSelect, onSearch.

OTP.usage: Ant's Input.OTP: label, length, characters (numeric, alphanumeric), mask, value; isComplete exposed; onChange, onComplete.

CurrencyInput.usage: Ant's InputNumber with a currency formatter: label, value (a number), currency, currencyOptions (a currency Select before it), locale, precision, currencyDisplay, min, max; formattedValue exposed; onChange, onPressEnter.

PhoneInput.usage: An Ant Input with a country Select (flag, calling code): label, value (E.164), defaultCountry, onlyCountries, allowCountryChange, showFlag, allowClear; country, countryCode, formattedValue, isValidNumber exposed; onChange, onPressEnter.

Password.usage: Ant's Input.Password: label, value, placeholder, visibilityToggle, showStrength, minLength, allowClear; strength exposed; onChange, onPressEnter.
